# Project Ariadne — Documentation

> Ariadne is an open protocol for **cognitive persistence** and **verifiable
> cognition** in multi-agent systems: it records that an agent reasoned, what
> state resulted, and makes that record cryptographically verifiable and
> re-interpretable. Bring your own cognitive architecture.

Most Ariadne implementations are done by AI coding agents. This file, the
companion AGENTS.md, and the Ariadne Docs MCP server exist so those agents
implement the protocol from its normative text instead of guessing (which
produces non-conforming adapters).

## Implementing the protocol

- Prefer the **Ariadne Docs MCP server** for exact lookups — it returns
  governance rules, conformance vectors, sections, and hash preimages verbatim
  with citations: `search_spec`, `get_governance_rule` (G-1..G-36),
  `get_conformance_vectors` (e.g. WF-004 or a family like WF), `get_section`,
  `get_hash_preimage`, `corpus_info`.
- Hash preimages, field order, and governance rules are **normative and exact**
  — read them, do not infer them. A wrong field set or order produces a
  different content hash and a non-conforming implementation.

## Normative documents (open corpus)

- SPEC.md — the canonical protocol specification (§1–§22; governance G-1..G-36)
- IMPLEMENTATION-BFM.md / CONFORMANCE-BFM.md — branch/fork/merge
- IMPLEMENTATION-CROSS-EPISODE-LINKING.md / CONFORMANCE-CROSS-EPISODE-LINKING.md — §20
- IMPLEMENTATION-LAYER3.md / CONFORMANCE-LAYER3.md — §21 Workflow & Execution DAG
- IMPLEMENTATION-PHASE3.md / CONFORMANCE.md — Phase 3 (witnesses, proof chains)
- GLOSSARY.md, CHANGELOG.md, VERSIONING.md

## Optional

- A public web assistant (Clotho-lite) answers questions grounded in these same
  documents, citing the same passages the MCP server returns.
